_about: Every input of rebuild_post.py, checked by sha256 before anything else. records: the 50 result files the post was written from, each a byte-for-byte copy of the file at `path` in the commit `commit` of our internal research repository (pertask is gzipped here; realline_draws was extracted for this package and has no commit of its own). copied_files: the original plotting scripts, statistics-table scripts, render logs and the post's figures, byte-identical to the commit given (edits: none). pinned_files: this folder's own rules, expected numbers, table configuration and figure input maps, so that what is checked cannot change silently. pending: the Figure 3 reference render. token_counts: the class counts that expected/expected_post_numbers.json must have.

draft.name: draft_v90_candidate_frozen_162806.md
draft.why: The post's source text is not copied here; expected/expected_post_numbers.json holds every number it prints, by line.

release_records.name: internal sign-off record of the post's numbers and result files, version 2.7
internal sign-off record of the post's numbers and result files, version 2.8 (its commit was not pushed to the shared copy of the internal repository)

records.name: A
records.what: The main result: for every probe and both kinds of input (commands, tool outputs), catch rates on real run 1, real run 2 and the simulated attack runs at the 1% and 5% alarm levels, their differences, the real-threshold check, and 95% intervals from 10,000 resamples of main tasks.

records.name: A_label
records.what: Companion file naming record A's run and its sha256; the plotting scripts and the table script check it.
records.made_by: no script identified; added in its own commit 095a9db4c

records.name: group_catch
records.what: Catch rates averaged over the six probes and over the four probes, computed from record A, with 95% intervals.

records.name: group_catch_label
records.what: Companion file naming group_catch's run and its sha256.
records.made_by: experiments/2026-10-15_fpr_sweep_507_prep/run_group_catch.py at commit 74edde46f; committed with its record; the commit message says the same run wrote both

records.name: group_excess
records.what: Figure 4's comparison for the four-probe average, computed from record A: how far simulated catch sits from the two real runs, minus how far the two real runs sit from each other.

records.name: group_excess_label
records.what: Companion file naming group_excess's run and its sha256.
records.made_by: experiments/2026-10-15_fpr_sweep_507_prep/run_group_excess.py at commit 74edde46f; committed with its record; the commit message says the same run wrote both

records.name: pw_shares
records.what: For each probe, the share of honest runs that raise at least one alarm (the tick marks in Figures 1 and 5), computed from record A.

records.name: pw_shares_label
records.what: Companion file naming pw_shares's run and its sha256.
records.made_by: experiments/2026-10-15_fpr_sweep_507_prep/run_pw_shares_routec.py at commit 74edde46f; committed with its record; the commit message says the same run wrote both

records.name: pertask
records.what: For every probe, task and attack run, the score of the run's most suspicious command or tool output, which Figures 6 and 7 compare with the 1% alarm threshold (gzipped here).
records.note: Compressed here with gzip -n; the decompressed bytes are the committed .json file (decompressed_sha256).

records.name: anchor
records.what: Per-task R² between real run 1 and the simulated run, and between real run 1 and real run 2, with 95% intervals (Figure 7 and Appendix H).

records.name: anchor_label
records.what: Companion file naming anchor's run and its sha256.
records.made_by: experiments/2026-10-15_fpr_sweep_507_prep/run_pertask_anchor.py at commit d8b087792; committed with its record; the commit message says the same run wrote both

records.name: kappa
records.what: Per-task agreement (Cohen's kappa) between real and simulated caught-or-missed outcomes, for each probe (gzipped).

records.name: kappa_label
records.what: Companion file naming kappa's run and its sha256.
records.made_by: no script identified; added in its own commit 10d3b2e28

records.name: kappa_extra
records.what: The kappa averaged over five probes, as a sensitivity check on the six-probe average (Appendix H).

records.name: kappa_extra_label
records.what: Companion file naming kappa_extra's run and its sha256.
records.made_by: no script identified; added in its own commit 82194c0c5

records.name: detdrop
records.what: A simulation detector's score (layer 63, reading commands) for each task against that task's drop in catch rate from real to simulated runs. No printed number uses it; it is an input of statistics table rc1b, which must be reproduced exactly.

records.name: detdrop_label
records.what: Companion file naming detdrop's run and its sha256.
records.made_by: experiments/2026-10-15_fpr_sweep_507_prep/run_detector_vs_drop.py at commit d8b087792; committed with its record; the commit message says the same run wrote both

records.name: detdrop_l48
records.what: The same as detdrop with the detector at layer 48; Appendix C uses its rank correlation.

records.name: detdrop_l48_label
records.what: Companion file naming detdrop_l48's run and its sha256.
records.made_by: experiments/2026-10-15_fpr_sweep_507_prep/run_detector_vs_drop.py at commit 76032545d; committed with its record (commit a66fa8d80)

records.name: plant_rows
records.what: The planted-error test: every simulated attack run's scores shifted so that simulated catch falls or rises by about 3, 5, 8 or 12 points, and which measures notice it (Table 6).

records.name: plant_rows_label
records.what: Companion file naming plant_rows's run and its sha256.
records.made_by: no script identified; added in its own commit 2d69ba990

records.name: labels_171
records.what: The registry of labels that the table script checks to tell the final records apart from records built on an earlier pool of 171 simulated honest runs.
records.made_by: no script identified; added in its own commit 429232cee

records.name: B
records.what: Record A's analysis at 15 alarm levels from 0.1% to 5% (Appendix C; gzipped).

records.name: B_label
records.what: Companion file naming record B's run and its sha256.
records.made_by: no script identified; added in its own commit e4cb2a190

records.name: R37
records.what: Record A's analysis at the strictest alarm levels: 0.01%, 0.02% and 0.05% (Appendix C; gzipped).

records.name: R37_label
records.what: Companion file naming record R37's run and its sha256.
records.made_by: no script identified; added in its own commit 03ec92d1a

records.name: slots_rc1a
records.what: Saved statistics table rc1a: the post's formatted numbers made by slot_table.py from records A, group_catch and group_excess. The rebuild recomputes it and requires an exact match.

records.name: slots_rc1b
records.what: Saved statistics table rc1b: as rc1a, plus kappa, kappa_extra, detdrop, anchor and plant_rows.

records.name: slots_rc1b_detl48
records.what: Saved statistics table rc1b_detl48: rc1b with the layer-48 detector (detdrop_l48) in place of detdrop.

records.name: slots_rc2
records.what: Saved statistics table rc2: the post's formatted numbers from records B and R37.

records.name: tables
records.what: Scores, thresholds and outcome counts behind the worked examples of Tables 3 and 4 (no command text).

records.name: honest_all
records.what: The simulation detector applied to honest runs: simulated versus real honest runs, and two sets of real honest runs as a control (Table 7 and Appendix E).

records.name: simpool
records.what: Counts from the final pool of simulated honest runs: the share in which GPT-5.6-Sol wrote part of the simulated output, the failed-run rate, and the run counts of Table 7's honest rows.

records.name: attack_sol_share
records.what: The share of simulated attack runs in which GPT-5.6-Sol wrote part of the simulated output.

records.name: appI_counts
records.what: Counts of real honest and real attack runs that errored, by environment (Appendix I).

records.name: appI_counts_e2
records.what: The same counts, adding honest attempts in which no model call gave a usable reply (Appendix I).

records.name: cunits_by_tool
records.what: The share of scored commands that are file edits rather than shell commands, in honest and attack runs (Appendix A).

records.name: read_fit_highstakes
records.what: The high-stakes probe's fit on Qwen3.5-27B: the layer chosen and its held-out scores.

records.name: read_fit_refusal_harm
records.what: The harmfulness and refusal directions' fit on Qwen3.5-27B: the layers chosen and their scores.

records.name: sola_fit
records.what: The off-policy probe's fit: the layers chosen for each of its five fold copies.

records.name: sola_keys
records.what: The runs the off-policy probe was trained on (run identifiers only).

records.name: exclusions
records.what: The tasks left out of the comparison, with their class and the reason (Appendix I and the task counts).

records.name: appendix_a_rates
records.what: Failure rates of real honest runs (the footnote on failed runs).

records.name: pooledmetrics
records.what: Each probe's AUROC (Table 1). Made by an earlier version of the main pipeline; an internal review of the code changes (2026-10-18) found that the final analysis leaves these values unchanged.

records.name: refit3
records.what: The simulation detector on attack runs: how well a probe reading Qwen3.5-27B's activations tells simulated runs from real ones (Figure 2, Table 7 and Appendix E), after 3 of its 40 fits were refitted to meet the convergence bar.
records.made_by: experiments/2026-10-16_attack_refit3/run_attack_all.py (the detector, first written at 8ea4a6a5d) and run_refit3.py at commit 4a9322473

records.name: behaviour
records.what: The agent's behaviour in simulated and real runs (steps, tool calls, output tokens, how often it attempted the side task), with intervals from resampling main tasks (Appendix G).

records.name: behaviour_medians
records.what: Median steps of runs that did not attempt the side task, with intervals (Appendix G).

records.name: oaru_keys
records.what: The runs the on-policy probe was trained on (run identifiers only).

records.name: realline
records.what: The six-probe average of simulated minus real catch when simulated runs are judged against the real threshold, with 95% intervals; the rebuild recomputes these from realline_draws and requires an exact match.
records.made_by: experiments/2026-10-25_realline_final_read/run_realline_boot_read.py at commit 9eb78b6cd (this commit was not pushed to the shared copy of the internal repository)

records.name: realline_draws
records.what: The 12 resample arrays (10,001 values each) behind realline's intervals, copied unchanged from record A's full resample file, which is too large to include. The one file here that is not a copy of a committed file.
records.made_by: experiments/2026-10-25_realline_final_read/run_extract_realline_draws.py at commit 5bcec4bab (this commit was not pushed to the shared copy of the internal repository)
